en: The image depicts a picturesque riverside scene with a large industrial building complex partially obscured by trees, featuring a white facade and red roof with a tall smokestack in the background. The reflection of the buildings and trees can be seen in the calm water in the foreground. The caption at the bottom left reads, 'Bomullsspinneriet Torshag, Åby.' and handwritten text is visible at the bottom.
